title: Sprout fixes are now one-click — Apply buttons next to each suggestion · Sprout 的每条建议都带「应用」按钮,一键改色
summary:
Each fix Sprout proposes now has an **Apply** button next to it in the Design Check panel. Click it and the change writes straight into the draft, the canvas re-renders, and the affected block flashes so you see exactly what changed.

How it works:
• New backend tool `propose_design_swap` — Sprout calls it once per fix with the block id + field + new brand token. The tool validates everything (block exists, field is valid for that block type, token is in the brand palette) and returns friendly labels for the button.
• Each successful tool call surfaces as an Apply card under Sprout's prose, with from→to colour swatches so you see the swap before clicking.
• "Apply all · 全部应用" CTA on top when there's more than one suggestion.
• Applying writes via the same save path as manual edits — undo/Revert in the editor still works.

Sprout 现在提的每条修改建议旁都有「应用」按钮:点一下就直接改到草稿,画布实时刷新,目标模块还会闪一下让你看清改了哪。新增 `propose_design_swap` 工具,Sprout 每提一条建议就调用一次,工具会校验后返回友好标签;前端把成功的建议渲染成可点的卡片,带颜色对比预览,多条时还可「全部应用」。
